images.alt: Several 4WDs are parked in the snow beside the river on Macetwon Road. Photo credit: Kevin Marlow, Shotover 4WD Club.

post.text:
🚨 #Arrowtown residents and outdoor lovers: Join us on 7 July from 5:30-6:30pm at the Arrowtown Rugby Clubrooms to discuss the future of #Macetown Road. Your voice matters. Learn about new access systems and fees that preserve this iconic landmark for everyone. Don’t miss it. 
#4WD #publicaccess
